name: @mms/shell
description: The MMSBUILD two-row product shell (Product Hub row + specialist row) and the UI primitives it renders with. Consumed as source by every MMS product — Instatic (MMS CMS), OpenDesign (MMS Design), and anything added later.
_peerNote: Ranges, not pins. This library is consumed as source by products on different React majors — OpenDesign is on 18.3.1, Instatic on 19.2.5 — so pinning one product's exact version contradicts what this package is for. Widening the range does NOT by itself make both work at runtime: a bare `react` import inside this package still resolves by walking up to OpenDesign's node_modules, which is why Instatic's DOM tests fail. That needs the monorepo on one React; see docs/plans/phase-6-plan.md.
